properties.name: `GraphRead` exists — the second trait in this crate after `LlmBackend` — and `granularity` is the first module to stand behind it rather than inside `DesignGraph`. Its body became a free `granularity_report(&dyn GraphRead)` with a one-line inherent method left behind, so no caller changed. Three tests prove the boundary: the report runs over a design that is two Vec's with no store at all; the same module cannot tell a real DesignGraph from a fake sharing no code with it; and an unknown node type reaches the caller as an error rather than as an empty design, with a control case so the assertion is not vacuous.
